about_the_game:
Unravel the Hidden Powers of the Cosmos in Age of Wonders 4: Secrets of the Archmages. Follow the footsteps of Athla’s renowned Wizard Kings. Discover the secret arts they learnt and face the perils left in their wake as they ventured through the most infamous Worlds of the Astral Sea.

Contains new story realms, narrative content, tomes and wildlife units.
